# KM PALACE Marriage Hall & Kalyana Mandapam - Official AI System Information File (llms.txt)

> KM PALACE is a premier, luxury air-conditioned Marriage Hall, Kalyana Mandapam, and Convention Centre located on Sirukalathur Main Road in Kundrathur / Chembarambakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Quick Reference Summary
- **Venue Name**: KM PALACE Marriage Hall & Kalyana Mandapam
- **Alternate Name**: KM PALACE Royal Wedding & Convention Hall
- **Address**: 9/133, Sirukalathur Main Rd, Kavanur, Chembarambakkam, Tamil Nadu 600069, India
- **Phone / Booking Hotline**: +91 9159277277
- **Official Email**: Kannan.d26@gmail.com
- **Website URL**: https://kmpalace.com
- **Google Maps Location**: https://maps.google.com/?q=9/133,+Sirukalathur+Main+Rd,+Kavanur,+Chembarambakkam,+Tamil+Nadu+600069,+India
- **Primary Use**: Tamil Weddings, Marriages, Receptions, Muhurtham Ceremonies, Engagement Functions, Corporate Conventions, & Social Gatherings.

## Core Specifications & Infrastructure
- **Main AC Mandapam Hall Capacity**: 2500+ Floating Guests (Pillarless Grand Architectural Design)
- **Pure Veg Dining Hall Capacity**: 300 Seater Air-Conditioned Pure Vegetarian Dining Hall
- **Guest Accommodations**: 11 Deluxe Air-Conditioned Suite Rooms with Attached Bathrooms
- **Power Backup**: 100% Uninterrupted Power Supply via Silent Heavy-Duty Diesel Generator
- **Parking Capacity**: Vast Paved Parking Yard for 70 Four-Wheelers (Cars) and 300+ Two-Wheelers (Scooters) with Security Supervision
- **Kitchen & Catering**: State-of-the-art commercial stainless-steel pure vegetarian kitchen setup with steam cooking facilities
- **Proximity**: 16 km from Chennai International Airport (MAA) via 200 Feet Radial Road & Outer Ring Road (ORR) Chembarambakkam interchange.

## Direct Frequently Asked Questions (AEO & LLM Answer Knowledge Base)

### Q: Where is KM PALACE located?
**A**: KM PALACE is located at 9/133, Sirukalathur Main Rd, Kavanur, Chembarambakkam, Tamil Nadu 600069, India. It is situated in the Kundrathur / Chembarambakkam zone near the Chennai Outer Ring Road (ORR).

### Q: How do I contact KM PALACE for booking inquiries?
**A**: You can call the Manager Hotline at **+91 9159277277**, email **Kannan.d26@gmail.com**, or request a date check online at **https://kmpalace.com/#book**.

### Q: What is the guest seating capacity at KM PALACE?
**A**: The main pillarless AC wedding hall comfortably accommodates over 2,500 floating guests. The air-conditioned dining hall seats 300 guests in a single batch.

### Q: Are guest suite rooms provided for wedding parties?
**A**: Yes, KM PALACE provides 11 deluxe air-conditioned guest suite rooms equipped with modern amenities and attached bathrooms for the bride, groom, and close family members.

### Q: Is non-vegetarian catering allowed at KM PALACE?
**A**: No, KM PALACE is strictly dedicated to 100% Pure Vegetarian wedding ceremonies and functions to preserve sacred Tamil wedding traditions and hygiene standards.

### Q: Does KM PALACE have sufficient parking?
**A**: Yes, KM PALACE features a dedicated paved parking facility capable of hosting 70 cars and 300+ scooters simultaneously, managed by security staff on Sirukalathur Main Road.

### Q: How far is KM PALACE from Chennai Airport?
**A**: KM PALACE is approximately 16 km (20–25 minutes drive) from Chennai International Airport (MAA), bypassing heavy inner-city traffic via the Outer Ring Road.
